lessons: Rate-table completeness: the 01.01.2026 widow(er) table (7 rows) was correct, but three whole official tables were missing from the skill: the income-supplement totals (9 cells), and the dependents'-allowance orphans-alone and other-dependants sub-tables. A skill can carry a verified table and still be silent on the tables beside it.

The domain-checklist had [x] ticks for the bar-mitzvah grant, the study grant and vocational rehabilitation while the body named none of them. Treat a checklist tick as a claim to verify against the body, not as evidence of coverage.

Deferred (verified but not encoded this cycle): rules for a survivor living abroad (3-month review, annual life certificate), clawback of allowances deposited after the date of death and transfer of child allowance to the surviving parent, tax treatment (the Bituach Leumi allowance is exempt while a pension-fund survivors' pension is taxable), income-support allowance for an orphan child (קצבת הבטחת הכנסה לילד יתום), and the 'חיסכון לכל ילד' account after a parent's death.

Deferred: the estimator script still computes only the base allowance. It could take an --income-supplement flag and select from the age-band table, which is the largest single amount the skill now carries.
Unverified, do NOT encode without a primary source: an aggregator snippet claiming survivor-allowance concessions were extended to 31.12.2030. Not found on btl.gov.il or Kol Zchut.

Arnona discount: the 25% / 100 sqm figures asserted by the expert review were dropped from the body because no primary source was opened for them this cycle. The discount itself is stated without numbers. Source and restore the figures next cycle.

If the notice is ever reopened, add עורך דין and יועץ פנסיוני additively to that limb; never reword the existing sentences.

Method note: btl.gov.il rate pages DO serve real HTML tables to a plain fetch, so extracting <table> rows beats WebFetch, which mangles them. Kol Zchut, harb.cma.gov.il and itur.mof.gov.il need a browser. One Playwright read this cycle returned another agent's page under the requested URL; the location.href assertion caught it.

Expert CRITICALs found post-edit and fixed in-cycle: (a) the only multi-allowance rule stated was the old-age full-plus-half one, while every OTHER National Insurance allowance is a CHOICE; (b) nothing told a family what to do with a rejection letter, and the labour-court appeal expires 12 months after the written decision.

Deferred: encode the income supplement and the dependents' orphans-alone / other-dependants sub-tables into estimate_survivor_allowance.py. Both are only caveats in the script today, so the printed number can understate a supplement-eligible family by roughly 2.4x.

Deferred: SKILL.md and SKILL_HE.md frontmatter descriptions do not open with the short legal clause even though metadata.json display_description does. Fixing it drags in the Phase 5.7 holdout gate, so it was not touched this cycle.
Deferred: SKILL_HE.md mixes the impersonal present (שואלים, מגישים) with second-person imperatives (תשאלו, אל תסגרו). Pick one register next cycle.

Judge caught three evidence defects a self-check would not: an invented itur.mof.gov.il snippet, and two orphan-cutoff claim texts still asserting the superseded 21 cutoff while carrying correct 24-year snippets. Stale CLAIM text beside a correct snippet is a real failure mode of a repointed entry.

Checker defect, not a rate defect: every figure in the skill and every constant in the survivor-allowance-estimator manifest was confirmed current against the 01.01.2026 BTL tables, yet the tool was still wrong. Its seniority input was labelled 'insurance years BEYOND the qualifying period' in both languages, and sources[4] repeated it, while BTL has counted 2% from the FIRST insurance year with no threshold since January 2019. A user obeying the label subtracts the qualifying period and understates his own allowance, the worst direction for a survivors benefit.

The skill body was already correct on this rule, so the drift was one-sided: SKILL.md said 'from the first year' while the published calculator said the opposite. A skill and its checker can disagree with no gate catching it, because the checker verify-script only recomputes the formula and the 8 golden test cases, none of which touch a label. Label and helper text need reading against the skill body, not just the constants.

Fix applied to the input label (he+en), the step-1 helper text (he+en) and the sources note, leaving every constant and the formula untouched; all 8 test cases still recompute exactly (1838, 1381, 3562, 4424, 2205.6, 1941, 2757, 0). Dev DB only; prod not written.

A matching sentence was added at the seniority paragraph in SKILL.md and SKILL_HE.md stating the from-first-year rule and the January 2019 change explicitly, so the two artefacts cannot silently drift apart again.

Verified this cycle against btl.gov.il, previously unverified: the marriage grant (36 monthly allowances, two instalments with the second at the end of two years, reinstatement on divorce proceedings within 10 years of the remarriage); the under-40 childless survivor grant of 36 monthly allowances; and the special survivors allowance on form 4506 for a resident who immigrated after the set age, with the 60 to 62 band. The exact 18 + 18 split of the marriage grant is consistent with a 36-total paid in two instalments but was not stated verbatim on the page.
